# 工程材料正文陪读：Skill engineering module proof

## 这一节先看什么

先看处理过的一手正文，再看旁批。这里保留用途、触发条件、用户意图、工作流、约束、失败条件、输出要求和设计亮点；运行外壳、重复命令和机器证据留在审计层。

## 处理过的一手正文

### 模块 1

> Route vague user intent to a bounded capability. First identify material type and current goal. Then choose one downstream path, or present two to three candidates with reasons. The router must explain why the selected path matches the trigger signal and why near-neighbor paths were not selected. It must not perform the downstream task itself.

### 模块 2

> Before generating interpretation, record source scope, coverage status, and location references. Mark which files are primary sources and which are derived material. Coverage can be sample, partial, or full. Partial coverage can support a catalog map, local map, or structure diagnosis, but not a grounded global map.

### 模块 3

> Evaluate whether the final sample helps the reader. Check that reader-facing pages are separated from audit data, audit evidence is preserved, first-hand body is not replaced by an AI summary, claims have specific references, technical insights are not generic praise, overpromoted claims are downgraded, and machine validation is kept separate from human acceptance.

## AI 旁批

这组材料的重点不是目录顺序，而是每个模块在 Agent 工作流中的职责边界。

## 容易误读的地方

- capability-map 不是目录列表；它必须说明触发、输入、输出、验证和不适用边界。
- output-eval 只能表达机器检查结论，不能冒充人工阅读验收。
